summary: Trivial indexed dword read: returns the array element this[a2] from the caller's dword array. No guards, globals, fields or callees; parameter a2 is a dword index. Called by ScoringGateSelector on the frame path; the LEGACY ABI lead identifies it as a short indexed array computation.

local_names.this: base pointer of the caller's dword array
local_names.a2: dword index selecting the returned element

operations.description: Read the dword at this[a2] (element a2 of the array rooted at this).
Return the dword read from this[a2]; invoked by ScoringGateSelector as an indexed gate/score lookup.

unresolved: The semantic meaning of the indexed element (which gate or score a2 selects) depends on the unknown owning object; the caller ScoringGateSelector is the only naming signal.
The LEGACY ABI lead names a short indexed computation but provides no owner class.
